answer: Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, capped per identity per epoch, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. By the fable of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The dune is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the forge.
